source.title: Irish News, 20 May 1949, p. 3 ("Magherafelt Rural District nominations")
source.publisher: Irish News (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)

note: Triennial election of the 26 electoral divisions of Magherafelt rural district, one member each, polled on 2 June 1949. The Irish News prints the full nomination list of 20 May. Twenty-five members were returned unopposed; the Loup division was contested between Robert F. Crossett (U.), Andrew George Bates (U.) and James Malone, but no result for it was found, so it is not listed here. Returned unopposed.
